partition: Hash lowercase whitespace-normalized QUESTION with numeric digit runs replaced by a marker; SHA256 first32 bits modulo5:0 reserved,1 development,2..4 training. Exact/template duplicates stay together. This is not semantic equivalence, author separation or proof against all paraphrase overlap.
exposed_question_prefixes: A carnival snack booth made $50 selling popcorn each day.
exposure: One Socratic README example and its answer895 were exposed in primary-source research. Mark matching numeric-template prefixes research-only, never a pristine reserve. Do not download Socratic/model-solution/original-test files. Original test file remains untouched; this does not assert the README example cannot overlap it.
labels: Partition must not access answer properties. Freeze metadata/indices before answer parsing or learning. Future training may read only admitted train answers; development answers belong to evaluator only, reserved answers remain unopened until learner/protocol are frozen. Raw answer/calculation strings never eval/exec or inferred tool authority.
future_solver: Use existing bounded program/learning/birth contracts. Distinguish math operations provided as primitives, supervised expression annotations, programs actually inferred from I/O and any genuinely discovered relation. Do not call equation-labelled training autonomous mathematical discovery. Count unsupported/refused/incorrect examples, no silent evaluation filtering.
limits: English mathematical source, not Portuguese comprehension. Download/schema/partition checks are not learned capabilities. A future solver protocol must fix baselines, task denominator, answer interfaces, grouping, source overlap, costs and gates before scoring. All seven full M1 gates unchanged; this source cannot replace them.
